leads.drill: A 1 metre chip sample across a mineralized section of the quartz vein assayed 800 grams per tonne silver, 17.3 per cent lead, 0.6 per cent zinc and only trace gold (Minister of Mines Annual Report 1920). In 2011, diamond drill hole PT11-42 intersected an oxidized and brecciated sulphide vein that returned 3,610 grams per tonne silver and 1.33 per cent copper over 0.36 metres (Press Release - Silver Mountain Mines Inc., February 21, 2012).
